newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuban dissident jailed for 18 months.
newsitem.headline: Cuban dissident jailed for 18 months.

text.p: A member of one of Cuba's small and illegal dissident groups has been sentenced to 18 months jail for contempt of the authorities, and resisting the authorities, a dissident colleague said Tuesday.

Ana Maria Agramonte was condemned at a trial last week and was now in a jail in Havana, said Odilia Collazo of the partido Pro-Derechos Humanos (Human Rights Party). Agramonte, who belongs to another group called Movimiento Accion Nacionalista (Nationalist Action Movement) was arrested May 1.
Dissidents in Cuba have said that authorities arrested a dozen dissidents around May 1, when Cuba celebrates the annual international Workers' Day with a mass parade in Havana.
Collazo said that of those detained, Agramonte had been tried and four others were still being held in custody.
There was no word on the cases from Cuba's communist authorities, who rarely comment on the island's dissident groups or their activities.
